summary: A list of actions that opens over the page. It shows in the top layer while it has the open attribute.

open.description: The menu is showing. A script, or the menu button, adds and removes it.

root.note: A frame padded like a listbox. Flat gives it a ring, set in kit.config.json, because its fill is the ground's.

keys.ArrowDown, ArrowUp: Move focus to the next or the previous item, and wrap.
keys.Home, End: Move focus to the first or the last item.
keys.A letter: Moves focus to the next item that starts with it.
keys.Escape: Closes the menu and returns focus to where it was when the menu opened.
keys.Tab: Closes the menu; focus goes on to the next element.

events.toggle: The platform's own event, dispatched when the menu shows and hides.

guidance.text: It writes popover="manual" on itself when the author wrote no popover attribute.

notYet: A menu taller than the viewport scrolls, but does not yet keep the focused item in view by itself beyond what the browser does.
